{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, ensure we're only processing rows where status is 'completed'
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove commas from revenue and convert to float
completed_data['revenue_clean'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_data['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_revenue)"}
